Title: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 49 - August 2020

Body.Content:
This update provides fixes and download links for the latest versions of these Azure Site Recovery components:

  • Site Recovery Unified Setup and Site Recovery Mobility Agent (both are version 9.36.5696.1)—Used for Azure Virtual Machine (VM) replication as well as replication of on-premises VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure. 
  • Site Recovery configuration server OVF template (version 5.1.6315.0)—Used for replication of on-premises VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure. 
  • Site Recovery Provider (version 5.1.6315.0)—Used for replication of Hyper-V virtual machines to Azure. 
  • Recovery Services Agent (version 2.0.9188.0)—Used for replication of Hyper-V virtual machines to Azure.

Learn more and get the download links.
